bacteriological_definitions.total_coliforms: Total coliforms are organisms found in the environment, including on plants, animals, and humans. Northern Health uses them as indicator organisms; if present, other organisms may also be present.
bacteriological_definitions.fecal_coliforms: Bacterial contamination from human or animal waste (feces).
bacteriological_definitions.escherichia_coli: Bacterial contamination from human or animal waste (feces).

A.meaning: Not tested; likely sample is too long in transit to the lab.

B#.meaning: Number of non-coliform background bacteria colonies; high numbers (>200) may indicate deteriorating water quality.

OG.meaning: Overgrowth of bacterial colonies; not possible to count coliform bacteria.

R.meaning: Not tested; resample is likely required.

T.meaning: Not tested; likely sample is too long in transit to the lab.

TNTC.meaning: Too numerous to count; similar to OG.

bacteriological_guidelines.description: If exceeded, water is unsafe to use for drinking, washing vegetables, or oral hygiene.
If exceeded, water is suspect and further investigation is needed to determine safety of water system.
Although not pathogenic, exceedance suggests flushing/disinfection of distribution system.
